outcome.Summary: Added api/handler.go with NewHandler(s *Store) using Go 1.24 ServeMux patterns: GET /healthz (200 "ok", text/plain), POST /notes (validates non-empty trimmed title, returns 201 + note JSON), GET /notes (JSON array sorted by id, `[]` when empty, case-insensitive ?q filter on title/body), GET/DELETE /notes/{id} (200/204, 404 missing, 400 non-integer id), and 405 for other methods; all error responses are JSON {"error": ...} with Content-Type application/json. Added api/handler_test.go covering all endpoints via net/http/httptest. Verified with `go vet ./... && go test -count=1 ./...`, both pass.
